data.animaCaption: Seated before an open grimoire whose pages cast a faint violet glow onto her chin, she presses one hand over her velvet choker and meets your gaze with quiet courage. A single shaft of cool silver moonlight from the arched window cuts through the deep indigo shelves.
data.promptProse: Enclosed by towering dark-wood bookcases in deep nocturnal shadow, Ayachi Nene sits at an antique reading table wearing a layered black-and-violet gothic lace dress with a velvet choker and ruffled lace cuffs. An open leather-bound grimoire rests before her, its parchment emitting a gentle lavender shimmer onto her fingers and lower face as she places one hand gently against her chest and looks up with steady purple eyes. A crisp diagonal beam of silver moonlight pours through a tall arched window on the right, highlighting her silver twin tails while leaving the rest of the archive in hushed midnight blue.
data.story: 高窗洒进来的冷银月光只照亮了书桌一角。宁宁把那本记录着契约秘密的旧笔记轻轻推向你，按在胸口的手指虽然微微发颤，眼神却比以往任何时候都笃定——「这一次，我想把全部真相都交给你来看。」
